player_prompt.intro:
Wɔyɛ Player {player_id} wɔ {num_rounds}-round Rock-Paper-Scissors agorɔ no mu.
Wɔakyɛ ho asɛm nea ɛdi nsɛm pɛ, di nkonim wɔ nneɛma a ɛboro saa.
Wɔ kɔsɛe biara mu, kɔ ka kyɛw wɔ: '[rock]', '[paper]', anaa '[scissors]'.
Wobɛtumi de '[r]', '[p]', anaa '[s]' di dwuma sɛ ɛyɛ kasa a ɛte saa.

message.round_win: Asekyerԑ no awiei: Ɔbɔadeɛ {winner} di nkonim!

outcome.p0_wins: Ɔpanyin 0 na odii nkonim wɔ mmirika no mu dodow!
outcome.p1_wins: Ɔpanyin a odi kan no na odii nkonim wɔ mmirika dodow no ara mu!
